Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has announced a $2 billion commitment to new European AI investments, unveiled during a Paris meeting with French President Emmanuel Macron. The pledge represents a significant expansion of Nvidia's European footprint and signals the company's strategic bet on the continent's AI potential.

The investment comes on top of $8 billion in previous European commitments over the past year, marking a substantial acceleration of Nvidia's continental expansion. The company is taking equity stakes in four French startups: Doctolib, a healthcare platform; Genesis AI; Pigment; and Entalpic.

"Open-weight models are Europe's best route to narrow the gap with US and Chinese labs," Huang said at the Paris event, articulating a vision that positions European AI development on a distinct trajectory from the closed-weights approach dominant among American AI giants.

The timing of the announcement is notable. European AI labs have struggled to compete with the massive capital deployments of their American counterparts, with most frontier model development concentrated in the US and China. By championing open-weight models, Nvidia appears to be positioning itself as an infrastructure partner for European AI development rather than simply a chip vendor.

The four startups receiving investment represent diverse sectors. Doctolib has become one of Europe's largest digital health platforms, while the other three represent emerging AI capabilities in enterprise software and analytics. The investments suggest Nvidia's strategy extends beyond hardware partnerships to building a broader ecosystem of AI applications optimized for its hardware.

This European push comes amid intensifying global competition for AI infrastructure investment. The US has committed billions in domestic chip manufacturing through the CHIPS Act, while China continues to pour resources into domestic semiconductor development. Europe's approach—emphasizing open-weight models and application-layer innovation—represents a third path in the global AI race.
